description: unslop (github.com/heydamir/unslop) for DeepSeek Harness: a standalone MCP server that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface. Exposes unslop_references / unslop_read / unslop_snapshot / unslop_story as mcp__unslop__* tools, plus unslop_status / unslop_deps, and installs the unslop workflow skill.
